transcript.text: Good morning. Maintenance Control here — I've got a cargo-handling constraint I need to put on the table before we finalize pallet allocation today. I have an updated loan record for the avionics diagnostic module that came in this morning. It hasn't been posted to the battalion cargo board yet, but it directs that the module returns on the next available aircraft. That's today's bird. So from my side, the avionics diagnostic module needs to be on this flight.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Before we finalize anything, I need to put a medical logistics constraint on the table. The staged water-purification cartridges are lot W-17, and I confirmed with the water team this morning that their chemical-treatment reagent must remain within the powered pallet position for the entire flight. This updated handling note hasn't been added to the lift manifest yet, but the requirement stands — lot W-17 needs the powered pallet position.
